mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand for housing, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 3.5% triggers an expansionary monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and ultimately resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, signals a tight labor market, which leads to higher wages and increased consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and high payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic output, which leads to higher corporate earnings and ultimately results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals an increase in consumer demand, which leads to higher economic growth and ultimately results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high real personal consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate, combined with a strong increase in the consumer price index, signals an inflationary environment, which leads to decreased consumer spending and ultimately results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rate and high consumer price index (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, combined with a decrease in payroll employment, signals a weak labor market, which leads to decreased consumer spending and ultimately results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment and low payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in GDP signals a decrease in economic output, which leads to lower corporate earnings and ultimately results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low GDP (t-test p > 0.05).
